title: Italy's top scorers since 2000
brief: Name the ten players with the most goals for Italy in full internationals from 1 January 2000 to the end of the 2026 World Cup. Only goals from 2000 on count.
period: Full internationals from 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026

notes.Andrea Belotti: Andrea Belotti is 11th with 12, just outside.
notes.Antonio Di Natale: Antonio Di Natale is joint 12th with 11.
notes.Gigi Riva: Gigi Riva's 35 goals were all before 2000.
notes.Roberto Baggio: Roberto Baggio scored all 27 of his Italy goals before 2000.
notes.Filippo Inzaghi: Filippo Inzaghi has 19 since 2000 (25 in all).
notes.Alessandro Del Piero: Alessandro Del Piero has 17 since 2000 (27 in all).
notes.Christian Vieri: Christian Vieri has 13 since 2000 (23 in all).

checks: Counted year by year from national-football-teams.com's Italy pages for 2000 to 2026 (every player's caps and goals each year, including the few games it marks as non-FIFA, which the FIGC counts). For players who started after 2000, the totals match RSSSF's career totals (to 7 June 2026). For Inzaghi, Del Piero and Vieri, whose careers straddle 2000, the year-by-year tables in their Wikipedia articles give the same 2000 onwards figures (19, 17 and 13). Belotti: national-football-teams.com credits him with 13, but RSSSF and Wikipedia (year table and infobox) both have 12; 12 is used, so he is 11th. Kean's 13 includes his 2 goals in March 2026 (Transfermarkt match reports agree).
